fusions.name: Caught in the Open
fusions.desc: A shot at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, with a 20% chance to leave it [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hooves Planted
fusions.desc: A stamp that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stock Still
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Saw It Coming
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that would have hit you is rolled a second time against your dodge, and the second roll stands.
